about.short: SeaDays is a cruise planning and travel companion app that helps travelers organize voyages, track ships and ports, connect with fellow cruisers, and turn every sailing into a rewarding experience—from first booking to final disembarkation.
about.medium: SeaDays is a modern cruise planning and travel companion platform built for travelers who want more from every voyage. The app combines intelligent itinerary tools, ship and port discovery, social crew features, gamified milestones, and offline-ready planning in one polished experience. Whether you are preparing for your first cruise or your fiftieth, SeaDays helps you organize trips, track expenses, explore destinations, and stay connected with the global cruise community. Designed in Hamburg, Germany, SeaDays represents a new generation of travel technology focused on clarity, delight, and real utility at sea and ashore.
about.long:
SeaDays is a travel technology company building the definitive cruise planning and companion experience for modern travelers. Founded with a mission to make cruise preparation intuitive, social, and genuinely enjoyable, SeaDays brings together the tools cruisers actually need—trip organization, voyage analytics, ship and port intelligence, community coordination, and achievement-driven engagement—inside a beautifully designed mobile app.

The platform serves everyone from first-time sailors planning their maiden voyage to seasoned cruisers managing complex multi-leg itineraries. SeaDays helps users build shared packing lists, evaluate drink packages, discover ships and ports with rich editorial content, join roll calls with fellow passengers, and document maritime milestones through its Cruise Passport experience. Offline support ensures critical trip details remain accessible even when connectivity at sea is limited.

SeaDays is developed in Hamburg, Germany—a historic port city that reflects the product's maritime soul. The company operates at the intersection of travel, consumer technology, and community, with a product philosophy rooted in premium design, respectful data practices, and features that respect how people really plan cruises today.

For media, partners, and creators, SeaDays offers a growing ecosystem of planning intelligence, editorial Portside content, and social features that distinguish it from legacy cruise tools. This press kit provides official descriptions, visual assets, and contact channels for accurate, on-brand coverage of SeaDays and its mission to elevate cruise planning worldwide.

brandGuidelines.logoSpacing: Maintain clear space around the SeaDays logo equal to at least the height of the anchor mark in the wordmark. Never crowd the logo with text, borders, or competing graphics.
allowedVersions: App icon for store and product references
SVG for web and large-format print
misuseExamples: Do not stretch, skew, or rotate the logo
Do not change logo colors outside approved palette
Do not place the logo on busy backgrounds without sufficient contrast
Do not add effects such as shadows, outlines, or gradients to the logo
Do not use outdated or unofficial artwork
